title: One Real Hand
style: synth-pop ballad, 92 BPM, female belt vocals, layered octave harmonies, analog synth arpeggios, detuned Juno pads, piano ostinato, muted kick pulse, sub-bass swell, gated snare reverb, plate reverb, tape saturation, sidechain pumping, bittersweet longing, unresolved ache
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I heard you call for ghosts and dreams,
for hands that change with every need.
You want a crew of perfect souls
to fill the spaces you still bleed.

But I am only one real voice,
one body, one imperfect night—
I cannot split myself in two
to make your every fantasy right.

[Pre-Chorus]
I’ll try, I’ll try, I’ll meet you where I can
but I won’t pretend to be every plan

[Chorus]
I can’t be everything you seek,
the anchor and the fleeting spark,
the quiet talk, the wicked scheme,
the face that changes in the dark.

So stop collecting beautiful illusions—
commit to something that can stay.
One real hand is worth the weight
of all the ones that drift away.

[Verse 2]
You paint a life of separate souls,
each perfect in her fleeting place.
A different touch for every hunger,
a different name, a different face.

I could try to wear those masks for you,
to be the fire, the peace, the plot—
but every time I stretch that thin
a little more of me is lost.

[Pre-Chorus]
I’ll try, I’ll try, I’ll meet you where I can
but I won’t pretend to be every plan

[Chorus]
I can’t be everything you seek,
the anchor and the fleeting spark,
the quiet talk, the wicked scheme,
the face that changes in the dark.

So stop collecting beautiful illusions—
commit to something that can stay.
One real hand is worth the weight
of all the ones that drift away.

[Bridge]
You’re dreaming of a life so wide
no single heart could ever fill it.
But love is not a rotating cast—
it’s choosing one and meaning it.

I won’t compete with all your ghosts.
I won’t audition for a role.
If you still need a thousand someones
then keep them—just don’t ask for my soul.

[Final Chorus]
I can’t be everything you seek,
the anchor and the fleeting spark,
the quiet talk, the wicked scheme,
the face that changes in the dark.

So stop collecting beautiful illusions—
commit to something that can stay.
I’ll try to be the one who’s real
if you will meet me halfway.

[Outro]
Not a someone or a someone—
just me.
If that’s enough, then stay.
If it isn’t…
walk away.
